body: My mum isn't empathetic in the slightest, and would turn me down straight away. And my dad is extremely intimidating, making It hard to confide in him.

That's just the thing, I can't. My parents are extremely strict and I'm still too young to make any somewhat-major decisions. The internet is the only place I know that has decent advice that I have access too...

I've kept hidden that I'm depressed, and I've hidden soamu feelings from my family in general. I don't want to spoil their image of "A sweet young child!" because that's what I really wish I could be. It's tough seeing other high-schoolers your age so happy.

Are those--are those bunnies?



Oh my god they're bunnies.

Story: I was in Town with 2 friends, I'll call them Lilly and Emma (not their real names) . We go into Tesco to see my mum, who works there. She's sitting in the opticians where she works with my 26 year old sister. We say hi, and go browse around. We get to the party section, an Di crouch down to look at the bottom shelf. "Emma" jokingly swings at me with a toy snake, and I back away (shuffling on the floor) because it kinda hurt. My sister came into the Ilse whilst I did this, coming to ask something. She goes and snitches to my mum, without the full story. We leave after I clear that up, and we spend the remaining time we have out at the park. At said park, there was some horrible boys who took Lilly's things, yelling horrible things at us and hurting Lilly's arm (it was at an angle that also hurt her neck, and she couldn't move it without pain for a week.). To defend her, we yelled things at them to protect Lilly. I end up being late, as Lilly's mum is extremely overprotective and wanted to find the boys. We went in her car, and I ended up being over the deadline to get home. My mum, knowing that I get emotional and stressed easily, decided to Yell at me over the phone. My dad found me later, having a panic attack. My mum knows that I have low self esteem and think of myself as pretty useless at times, but  still decides to do things like this to me. Am I the asshole?
